defects.claim: The adapter binds `orgName`, `lastShippedAt` and `poolPercentUsed` on the dashboard wire, but nothing in the checkout sends them. The C16 producers return only window/stats/activity/projects, so in practice the header always shows "— … Last shipped —" and the Pool segment never appears
defects.evidence: src/lib/api/mockAdapter.ts:1064-1069 returns `{ window, stats, activity, projects }`, and src/lib/api/__tests__/fixtures/dashboard.json:3 has no such keys. The real values come from other sources: org name from `auth.org?.name` (src/design-system/components/AppHeader.vue:151) and pool from the allowance `percent_used` (src/lib/api/httpAdapter.ts:342,423 via `getAllowance`). The view never reads either source.

defects.claim: `stats.timeToPrMinutes` has no producer either, so the Time to PR card can never show a value
defects.evidence: mockAdapter.ts:1066 stats is `{ shipped, needsYou }` only, and dashboard.json:3 is `{ "shipped": 8, "needsYou": 2 }`.

defects.claim: The new GH-249 tests replace `mockAdapter.getDashboard` with a hand-built Dashboard containing the new fields. That proves nothing about the wire contract: no httpAdapter spec covers the new `toDashboard` mappings (src/lib/api/__tests__/httpAdapter.spec.ts:2036 still asserts only `{ shipped, needsYou }`), and the mock/fixtures were not updated in lockstep as CLAUDE.md requires.
The "no $ or tokens on a platform-key tenant" test never sets up a platform-key tenant (no platformKey or allowance state). It only checks static header text with `poolPercentUsed: 42`.
The Delivered "/100" denominator is a hard-coded literal, not a value from the payload, and the docblock does not record it as a design constant or trim.
The view ignores the org name the app already has (`auth.org.name`, used by AppHeader/ProfileView/ConnectionsView). Instead it falls back to '—' on every real payload.

not_verified: The "instance not running" degrade path was not traced end to end; only the unchanged `v-else` grid wrapper and the retained DEGRADED_METRIC_NOTE were checked.

The backend C16 console contract is outside this checkout, so it is unknown whether the server will ever emit `orgName`/`lastShippedAt`/`poolPercentUsed`/`timeToPrMinutes` under these camelCase names (the issue itself says `percent_used`).
